2608.02993.title: Neurosymbolic Reasoning with Incremental Knowledge for Sample Efficient Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
2608.02993.paper_summary: (Flat) Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents face significant challenges in environments with sparse rewards that require long-horizon reasoning. A compelling approach to improve sample efficiency is to incorporate knowledge into learning and decision-making. In standard Hierarchical RL (HRL), knowledge is encoded in a fixed, non-updatable form, such as architectural choices, and remains unchanged throughout learning. With fixed HRL, reasoning with incremental knowledge learned during exploration is impractical before sufficient environmental knowledge is acquired, leading to poor sample efficiency. In this work, we propose neurosymbolic HRL with {\em Incremental Knowledge (InK)}: symbolic high-level components perform {\em symbolic planning} (e.g. using $D^*$) on an updatable representation of current InK, while low-level goal-conditioned neural modules learn motion primitives through experience using reward shaping. Experiments on navigation tasks demonstrate that incorporating InK substantially improves sample efficiency. Additionally, to perform {\em optimal} symbolic planning given {\em prior} knowledge about the world, we develop Belief World Tree Search. The code is available at https://github.com/CPS-research-group/ink_bwts.
2608.02993.paper_summary_zh: (平面) 強化學習 (RL) 智能體在面對稀疏獎勵且需要長期推理的環境時面臨重大挑戰。改善樣本效率的一個引人注目的方法是將知識納入學習和決策過程中。在標準的層次強化學習 (HRL) 中，知識以固定的、不可更新的形式編碼，例如架構選擇，並在學習過程中保持不變。使用固定的 HRL，在獲得足夠的環境知識之前，利用在探索過程中學到的增量知識進行推理是不切實際的，這導致了較差的樣本效率。在本研究中，我們提出了具有 {\em 增量知識 (InK)} 的神經符號層次強化學習：符號高層組件在可更新的當前 InK 表示上執行 {\em 符號規劃}（例如使用 $D^*$），而低層目標條件神經模塊通過經驗學習運動原語，並使用獎勵塑造。導航任務的實驗表明，納入 InK 顯著改善了樣本效率。此外，為了在給定世界的 {\em 先驗} 知識的情況下執行 {\em 最優} 符號規劃，我們開發了信念世界樹搜索。代碼可在 https://github.com/CPS-research-group/ink_bwts 獲得。
